source: Item wear positions (opcodes 13, 14 and 27) of a recent OSRS cache, by item id
note: Slot numbers are the client's: 0 head, 1 cape, 2 neck, 3 weapon, 4 torso, 5 shield, 6 arms, 7 legs, 8 hair, 9 hands, 10 feet, 11 jaw. slot is the item's wearPos1; hides lists its wearPos2 and wearPos3, the slots the game server empties while the item is worn. status compares the snapshot item with the recent one: match, renamed, models_changed or renamed_and_models_changed (worn model ids differ).
